body:
We favour healthcare and large-cap banks both in the US and Europe. In the latter, we also lean into companies with strong domestic revenue exposure. In emerging markets, dispersion calls for selectivity. We lean into Brazil for commodity exposure and Mexico for its attractive valuations, alongside parts of Asia given improving fundamentals and AI-related tailwinds. Finally, private markets are playing a growing role in portfolios, offering potential differentiated sources of growth and access [...] Persistent uncertainty calls for increased focus on diversification and downside protection, in our view, with gold remaining our primary choice to hedge geopolitical risk. In equities, buffer strategies could help improve downside protection while enabling investors to remain invested. Amid less reliable stock-bond correlations, alternatives such as hedge funds could provide durable alpha through return dispersion and independence from market beta, alongside dynamic downside protection. [...] We maintain a high-quality investment grade credit core, with a continued focus on managing duration risk, while adding more resilient, all-weather strategies, including unconstrained approaches designed to deliver consistent income with lower market sensitivity.

We also tilt into certain plus sectors. We see potential opportunities in AT1s, where we like the sector makeup, although we stress selectivity and maintaining an active lens remain essential.
